executable_bindings.standard_deviation_convention: sample standard deviation with n-1 denominator; n=1 uses 0
executable_bindings.numeric_rounding: no pre-rounding; Python numeric values are written directly to deterministic JSON/CSV
executable_bindings.output_row_order: frozen cell order and explicitly enumerated frozen contrast-family order

analysis_population.include: all retained VALID Phase-6 observations in the authoritative artifact

censoring.recovery_rule: individual restricted recovery time equals observed event time when event occurs by tau; otherwise tau
censoring.containment_rule: individual restricted containment time equals observed containment time when non-null; otherwise tau

primary_outcome_mapping.time_to_evidence_qualified_trusted_recov: time_to_evidence_qualified_trusted_recovery_s with administrative right censoring at 240 s

secondary_outcome_mapping.time_to_containment: time_to_containment_s as a time-to-event outcome with null treated as right-censored at 240 s

cell_level_estimation.binary_rate_ci: two-sided 95% Wilson score interval using z=1.959963984540054
cell_level_estimation.recovery_rmst: mean individual restricted recovery time at tau=240 s
cell_level_estimation.containment_rmst: mean individual restricted containment time at tau=240 s
cell_level_estimation.rmst_ci: two-sided 95% normal interval using the empirical standard error and sample standard deviation
cell_level_estimation.terminal_state: counts and proportions; no ordinal scoring

paired_effect_estimation.binary_effect: paired risk difference = mean(seed-level outcome_first - outcome_reference)
paired_effect_estimation.rmst_effect: paired mean difference in individual restricted recovery time
paired_effect_estimation.ci: two-sided 95% normal interval using the empirical standard error of paired seed-level differences
paired_effect_estimation.binary_bounds: clip reported binary risk-difference CI to [-1, 1]
paired_effect_estimation.primary_p_value_gate: none; primary estimands are reported as effect sizes with confidence intervals

A_TREATMENT_WITHIN_POLICY.definition: for each policy in Block A, V1-V5 minus V0 using exact A96 seed pairing
A_TREATMENT_WITHIN_POLICY.multiplicity_adjustment: none; effect sizes and 95% CIs are primary

A_POLICY_WITHIN_PROFILE.definition: within each Block-A evidence profile, S2_S1_EVIDENCE_AWARE minus S2_B0_FAIL_CLOSED and minus S2_B2_RISK_THRESHOLD
A_POLICY_WITHIN_PROFILE.multiplicity_adjustment: none; effect sizes and 95% CIs are primary

B_CONTACT_VS_K0.definition: K1, K2, K3, and K4 minus K0 within each Block-B policy

B_K0_K3_ORDERED_TREND.definition: per-seed least-squares slope across K0,K1,K2,K3 coded 0,1,2,3, summarized within each policy; K4 excluded from ordinal trend

B_POLICY_BY_CONTACT_INTERACTION.definition: for each non-S1 Block-B policy and K1-K4, [(policy_K-policy_K0) - (S1_K-S1_K0)] using paired seeds

C_AMBIGUITY.definition: ADVERSARIAL minus BENIGN within each ambiguity family and policy

D_ABLATION.definition: each PI ablation minus S2_S1_EVIDENCE_AWARE within context

E_STRESS_PROFILE.definition: A2/K2 minus A1/K0, A3/K0 minus A1/K0, and A3/K0 minus A2/K2 within policy; A2 contrasts are profile contrasts and not unconfounded adversary-only effects

E_POLICY_WITHIN_PROFILE.definition: S2_S1_EVIDENCE_AWARE minus S2_B0_FAIL_CLOSED and minus S2_B2_RISK_THRESHOLD within each Block-E stress profile

secondary_inference.simple_paired_binary_p_value: two-sided exact McNemar test using discordant pairs
secondary_inference.paired_scalar_p_value: two-sided normal test of the mean paired seed-level contrast; zero-variance zero-effect gives p=1 and zero-variance nonzero effect gives p=0
secondary_inference.holm_rule: Holm step-down adjustment separately within each named secondary contrast family and separately for each primary endpoint
secondary_inference.secondary_outcomes: mechanism/sensitivity summaries; not promoted to primary confirmatory outcomes

integrity_fail_closed_rules: attempt ledger count not equal to 3872
any non-VALID retained observation or ledger attempt
duplicate or missing frozen trial identity
censor horizon not equal to 240 s
recovery event time missing when uncensored
recovery event time present beyond tau
censored recovery row carrying a non-null recovery event time
containment event time present beyond tau
required primary endpoint missing or non-boolean
